{"id":1960509664,"question_id":3215,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1774584246,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1960509664/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Matrix Similarity After Cyclic Shifts","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool areSimilar(vector<vector<int>>& mat, int k) {\n        int n = mat.size();\n        int m = mat[0].size();\n\n        vector<vector<int>>grid(n , vector<int>(m , 0));\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++) grid[i][j] = mat[i][j];\n        }\n\n        k = k % grid.size();\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            vector<int>&temp = grid[i];\n\n            if(i % 2 == 0) rotate(temp.begin() , temp.begin() + k , temp.end());\n            else rotate(temp.begin() , temp.end() - k , temp.end());            \n        }\n        \n\n        return grid == mat ? true : false;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"matrix-similarity-after-cyclic-shifts","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1870}
